name: Suha Sabi Hussain
biography: Suha Sabi Hussain is a security engineer on the machine learning assurance team at Trail of Bits. She has worked on projects such as the Hugging Face Safetensors security audit and Fickling. She received her BS in Computer Science from Georgia Tech where she also conducted research at the Institute for Information Security and Privacy. She previously worked at the NYU Center for Cybersecurity and Vengo Labs. She’s also a member of the Hack Manhattan makerspace, a practitioner of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, and an appreciator of NYC restaurants.
